title: Urushi Uruhashi
synopsis: Mihiro Kanayama is a third-year high school student who aspires to become a lacquerware craftsman. He is given a challenge by his grandfather, who tells him to "create a piece while thinking about the person who would use it." He didn't know how to go about it, until he meets Tsumugi Fukaya, a woman working at an inn. Pure emotions bloom within a young man dedicated to traditional craftsmanship. Though he may be clumsy in his first attempts, you will come to admire his determined perseverance! (Source: Manga Cross, translated)

title: Kyou Kara Tsukaeru Isekai Renai Manual
titleRomaji: Kyou Kara Tsukaeru Isekai Renai Manual
titleNative: 今日から使える異世界恋愛マニュアル
synonyms: A Love Manual You Can Use From Today
synopsis: Just as Haruchika Isezaki was confessing to his first love, he is suddenly summoned to another world. His summoner, the goddess Clementine, gives him an unusual mission: to make seven girls, destined to become the mothers of the next generation of heroes, fall in love again. These girls have lost their ability to love due to a curse cast by the Demon Lord. In other words, Haruchika must convince them all to fall in love with him! To return to his world and hear the answer to his confession, Haruchika accepts this mission and sets out to save another world through love. Having mastered the art of romance through his study of female psychology, his journey to fulfill their first loves begins — a romantic tale about saving another world through the power of love! (Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

synopsis: Eijun Sawamura had his heart set on the middle-school national baseball championships. But his team is eliminated thanks to a wild pitch thrown by Eijun himself. Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.
